subject: MedPlus regulated pilot - hosting posture and capacity ask
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@medplushealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-04-04T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: MedPlus regulated pilot — hosting posture discussion

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking the intro call yesterday. MedPlus is preparing a regulated pilot (patient-facing triage assistant) and we need to decide whether to run on Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) or Private (VPC / on-prem) for the first 6–12 months. High level constraints:

- Data type: de-identified PHI initially, but roadmap includes identifiable data inside 3–6 months per legal.
- Compliance: SOC2 + regional audit requirements; potential need for HSM/KMS integration.
- Target traffic: ~200 reqs/min peak initially; expected growth to ~1k reqs/min over 6 months.
- Latency target: 90th percentile <120ms for chat completions (short prompts), occasional long-form OK.
- Model: planning to use an open 70B-style encoder-decoder (we can share exact model later).

Can you send a short comparison of cost/lead time/risk for Dedicated vs Private, and any recommended capacity topologies (GPU types, node counts, burst/fallback options)? Also please attach any SOC2 evidence paths or how Redwood supports air-gapped workflows — procurement will need it.

Attached: MedPlus pilot requirements (PDF).

Best,
Eleanor
Director, Product — MedPlus Health

Attachment (1): medplus_mrp_requirements.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@medplushealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-04-04T11:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: MedPlus regulated pilot — hosting posture discussion

Eleanor — thanks for the clear summary and the PDF. Quick answers and an ask:

- Short answer: we can support the pilot on either Dedicated or Private. Dedicated gives fastest time-to-live (hours to provision reserved pool) with predictable throughput; Private (VPC or on-prem) offers tighter isolation and more direct control over key material but requires more lead time (2–8 weeks depending on VPC/KMS setup or 4–12 weeks for air-gapped on-prem).
- Immediate recommendation: start the pilot on a dedicated, reserved pool segmented for MedPlus with strict network policies and customer-managed KMS (if required). This lets you iterate while we finalize any HSM integration or on-prem steps.

Can you confirm: typical request size in tokens, % of long (>1024 tokens) completions, and whether you need on-disk persistence of logs in your VPC? That impacts NVMe sizing.

I'm looping Karthik (capacity) to draft a sizing delta (Dedicated vs Private) and Marissa (sales/contracting) for procurement/timeline.

Next step: quick call to review two capacity options tomorrow?

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-04-05T08:30:00-04:00
Subject: Internal — MedPlus pilot capacity sketch (Dedicated vs Private)

Team — I sketched two candidate configurations based on Eleanor's traffic and latency targets. Assumptions: 95% requests are short (<256 tokens), 5% long completions (~1.5k tokens), model is ~70B FP16-like; throughput estimates include typical batching and KV cache effectiveness (~20% token traffic saved).

Option A — Dedicated (recommended for pilot)
- Hardware: 8 x H100 80GB GPUs (NVIDIA H100-class) in a reserved pool; 2 nodes held for burst/maintenance buffer.
- Throughput: ~650 concurrent short sessions (approx), sustained ~12k tokens/sec after batching; 90th p95 latency target met for short prompts with per-request batching disabled for latency-critical calls.
- Isolation: tenant-level software isolation and dedicated pool; option to enforce VPC peering + customer-managed KMS for records-at-rest encryption.
- Lead time: 24–72 hours to reserve; provisioning + policy setup 1–3 business days.
- Estimated monthly infra cost (list): $65k–$95k (infrastructure only) — depends on sustained utilization and networking charges.

Option B — Private (VPC-hosted or on-prem)
- Hardware: 6 x H100 80GB (VPC) or 4 H100 + 2 x A100 80GB (on-prem mix) with dedicated NVMe and isolated network.
- Throughput: comparable peak throughput with slightly higher headroom for long-form due to local NVMe and tuned kernel paths; lower noisy-neighbor risk.
- Isolation: full customer VPC or on-prem control; HSM integration supported but adds setup and approval steps.
- Lead time: VPC + KMS ~2–4 weeks; air-gapped on-prem 6–12 weeks including acceptance tests.
- Estimated monthly infra cost: $95k–$140k (includes higher ops & network charges + support for private control plane).

Operational notes and fallbacks
- We recommend a staged approach: provision Dedicated reserve for pilot, enable strict routing and caching, run production-like load tests, and parallelize Private onboarding (KMS/HSM) in the background.
- Fallback: automatic routing to lower-cost compatible model (quantized) if capacity constrained; maintain a small burst pool dedicated for failover.
- Logging/retention: if MedPlus requires on-prem retention of logs, choose Private (or VPC with log export to customer's storage). Otherwise, Dedicated with encrypted export is fine.

I'll attach a quick configuration spreadsheet for numbers.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Eleanor / Procurement team — thanks for the detail and Karthik for the sizing draft. Short summary and recommended next steps:

Recommendation (pilot):
- Start on Redwood Dedicated: reserve an 8 x H100 pool segmented for MedPlus with strict routing and customer-managed KMS. This meets the latency SLOs and gets you live quickly while we complete compliance work.

Parallel workstreams (we'll run these in parallel to reduce overall calendar time):
1) KMS/HSM integration & SOC2 evidence collection — target 2–3 weeks (team: Security + Solutions).
2) VPC onboarding plan — if MedPlus decides to require VPC-level tenancy, we can scope the VPC config and network testing (2–4 weeks).
3) On-prem (air-gapped) path — longer lead time; only pursue if legal requires it.

Commercials / procurement items:
- We'll produce a pilot quote for 3 months with an option to convert to Reserved Capacity (12mo) should you want guaranteed throughput and discounts.
- DocuSign for the pilot SOW is here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123

Action items:
- Eleanor: confirm acceptance to start on Dedicated pool and whether you need HSM integration for pilot (yes/no).
- Procurement: if approved, please review the attached capacity_quote_v2.xlsx and indicate procurement constraints (PO terms, billing contacts).
- Tessa / Karthik: schedule a 30-min technical kickoff once procurement gives the OK.

Thanks — we can also join a procurement call to walk the quote.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Revenue — Redwood Inference
